When running in active mode and clocked from the main **PLL_CLK**, the CPU can run at three frequencies: **80 MHz**, **160 MHz**, and **240 MHz** [ESP32_TRM, Section 9.3.9, p. 188].

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

   The low-speed channel configuration registers follow the offset formula $0\text{xA0} + 0\text{x14} \times n$ [ESP32_TRM p.639].
